senses.gloss: 1. ह the thirty-third and last consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet (in Pāṇini's system belonging to the guttural class, and usually pronounced like the English h in hard; it is not an original letter, but is mostly derived from an older घ्, rarely from ध् or भ्).
2. ह m. (only L.) a form of Śiva or Bhairava (cf. नकुलीश)
a cipher (i.e. the arithmetical figure which symbolizes o)
calling, calling to the sound of a lute

3. ह ind. (prob. orig. identical with 2. घ, and used as a particle for emphasizing a preceding word, esp. if it begins a sentence closely connected with another; very frequent in the Brāhmaṇas and Sūtras, and often translatable by) indeed, assuredly, verily, of course, then &c. (often with other particles, e.g. with त्व् एव, उ, स्म, वै &c.; न ह, ‘not indeed’; also with interrogatives and relatives, e.g. यद् ध, ‘when indeed’; कद् ध, ‘what then?’ sometimes with impf. or pf. [cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 116]; in later language very commonly used as a mere expletive, esp. at the end of a verse), RV.; &c.
4. ह mf(आ)n. (fr. √ हन्) killing, destroying, removing (only ifc.; see अराति-, वृत्र-, शत्रुह &c.)
5. ह mf(आ)n. (fr. √ 3. हा) abandoning, deserting, avoiding (ifc.; see अन्-ओक- and वापी-ह)

1. हा ind. an exclamation expressive of pain, anger, astonishment, satisfaction &c. (= ah! alas! oh! ha! often before or after a voc. case, also repeated हा-हा cf. 1. हहा above, or followed by other particles, esp. धिक्, हन्त, कष्टम् &c.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.,
